Facts:
Two Informations, both dated March 29, 2010, charged Dalaguet with violating Section 5(b) of R.A. No. 7610.
Criminal Case No. F-10-49-MJ alleged that in December 2009, Dalaguet, through force, coercion, and intimidation, had sexual intercourse with [AAA], a 15-year-old minor, without her consent.
Criminal Case No. F-10-50-MJ alleged that in March 2010, Dalaguet, through force, coercion, and intimidation, had sexual intercourse with [AAA], a 15-year-old minor, without her consent.
On September 22, 2010, Dalaguet pleaded not guilty to both charges during arraignment.
On December 15, 2010, the parties stipulated to the identity of the parties, that the private complainant was a minor, that they were neighbors (houses five meters apart), and that on March 9, 2010, at approximately 6:00 AM, the accused entered the private complainant's house.
The defense admitted [AAA]'s birth certificate, dispensing with the local civil registrar's testimony, which confirmed [AAA] was 15 years old during the alleged incidents.
A joint trial was agreed upon by both parties.
The prosecution presented [AAA], EEE (AAA's grandfather), and Marretta Rubio as witnesses.
[AAA] testified on August 2, 2011, stating she knew Dalaguet as a neighbor and that he followed her when she pastured the family's cow and carabao.
[AAA] testified that in December 2009, Dalaguet followed her while she pastured the cow, carried her to a hut, and undressed her while she was lying down.
[AAA] testified that she struggled and shouted for help, but was unsuccessful due to Dalaguet's hold and the absence of nearby people.
[AAA] testified that Dalaguet inserted his penis at the outside portion of her vagina but was unable to penetrate.
[AAA] testified that she did not report the December 2009 incident because Dalaguet said she wouldn't be believed and her parents would maltreat her.
[AAA] testified that on March 9, 2010, Dalaguet sexually molested her at her house.
[AAA] testified that she did not shout during the March 2010 incident because Dalaguet warned her people would hear.
[AAA] testified that the March 9, 2010, incident occurred while her parents were away, and her sister, CCC (age 9), was told to leave the house by Dalaguet, which CCC did in order to attend school.
[AAA] testified that on March 9, 2010, after CCC left, Dalaguet held her hand, made her lie down, and undressed her, while also undressing himself.
[AAA] testified that EEE, her grandfather, caught Dalaguet sexually molesting her on March 9, 2010, and then maltreated her out of anger, and Dalaguet threatened to kill EEE, but was stopped by neighbor FFF.
[AAA] maintained that Dalaguet had sexual intercourse with her in December 2009 and March 2010 but that his penis did not penetrate her vagina.
[AAA] was brought to the Municipal Health Office for medical examination.
Dr. Andaya's medical certificate, admitted by the defense, indicated healed lacerations at the 1:00 and 5:00 o'clock positions of [AAA]'s genitalia on March 10, 2010.
EEE testified that he knew Dalaguet as a resident of the same barangay and identified him in court.
EEE testified that on March 9, 2010, he went to his son's house, where he saw Dalaguet sexually molesting [AAA] upon opening the kitchen door, after which Dalaguet ran away.
Rubio testified that she conducted a study report on [AAA]'s family based on an RTC order.
Rubio gathered information from a barangay official and interviewed [AAA]'s mother, BBB, but could not interview [AAA].
Dalaguet testified, denying the charges and claiming his arrest was illegal.
Dalaguet testified he went to [AAA]'s house on March 9, 2010, to retrieve his cellphone, which [AAA] refused to return.
Dalaguet admitted he was at [AAA]'s house on March 9, 2010, when she was alone, but denied seeing EEE.
Police officers arrested Dalaguet at his house in the afternoon of March 9, 2010.
Dalaguet denied the December 2009 incident.
On cross-examination, Dalaguet admitted [AAA] had a younger sister (CCC), who lived in the same house, and that [AAA]'s grandfather (EEE) lived five meters away.
Dalaguet stated EEE only arrived at the house after he left and only heard [AAA] shouting when he was already at work.
Dalaguet stated that [AAA]'s family owns a native house or "payag payag" where they would usually pasture the livestock.
Dalaguet stated that he stayed in his house the entire time in December 2009.
On July 13, 2016, the RTC found Dalaguet guilty beyond a reasonable doubt of two counts of rape.
The RTC sentenced Dalaguet to Reclusion Perpetua, or a period of 20 years and one day to 40 years for each count of rape, and ordered him to pay [AAA] ₱100,000.00 for actual damages and ₱100,000.00 for moral damages.
The RTC found that [AAA] usually pastures the family cow and carabao at the place where the family has a "payag-payag," which was admitted by Dalaguet.
For the second incident of rape on May 9, 2010, the RTC gave weight and credence to the testimony of AAA's grandfather, EEE, who witnessed Dalaguet sexually molesting AAA.
The RTC gave consideration to the medical findings of Dr. Andaya, who testified that she physically examined AAA on May 10, 2010 and found lacerations in AAA's hymen.
Dalaguet appealed to the CA.
On June 25, 2019, the CA affirmed with modification Dalaguet's conviction.
The CA found Dalaguet guilty beyond a reasonable doubt for two counts of lascivious conduct under Section 5(b) of R.A. No. 7610.
The CA held that the prosecution failed to prove beyond a reasonable doubt all the elements of rape through sexual intercourse under Article 266-A (1a) of the Revised Penal Code (RPC), because sexual intercourse was not proved beyond a reasonable doubt, as AAA consistently stated that Dalaguet was not able to penetrate her vagina.
The CA sentenced Dalaguet to suffer the indeterminate penalty of eight (8) years and one (1) day of prisi[ó]n mayor as minimum, to seventeen (17) years, four (4) months and one (1) day of reclusion temporal as maximum, for each count of violation, and is ORDERED to pay private complainant AAA the amounts of [₱]50,000.00 as civil indemnity, [₱]50,000.00 as moral damages, and [₱]50,000.00 as exemplary damages, for each count of violation, with legal interest of six percent (6%) per annum from the date of finality of this judgment until full payment.
AAA testified that Dalaguet committed lascivious conduct against her, when on at least two occasions, Dalaguet made her lie down and undressed her, while he also undressed himself.
At the time of the offense, AAA was 15 years old, and was coerced to engage in lascivious conduct.
On July 29, 2019, Dalaguet filed his Notice of Appeal before the CA.
When the case was brought before the Supreme Court, the parties adopted their Appellant's and Appellee's Briefs, respectively, in lieu of their Supplemental Briefs.
